nextExecutableAction: Lead accepts this artifact-only preflight. Once wave0 is committed and all eight producer typed-interface/migration/scenario receipts are accepted, re-read digest-changed seams; obtain the common CRM owner, WP-26-compatible source visibility and meeting association ports; resolve GetEntityContext cursor/filter/budget and status-to-triad contracts. Then extend the single CRM contracts/query/repository and existing dossier surface in dependency order; apply the selected migration and execute the full UI/API/agent privacy/negative-control/restart/reconnect verification before any completion claim.
risks: Root-owned uncommitted integration may change every inspected seam; hashes bind observations to worktree content, not dispatch HEAD.
The CRM contract/command/repository files are shared across packages; independent creation would overwrite accepted domain interfaces or introduce competing stores.
Name/alias scans produce false associations, title-based merges and N-by-N work; canonical indexed source links must replace shared aggregation, not merely add mail to DossierSources.

Company visibility can leak linked private mail through totals, cached titles, last-touch ordering, cursor metadata, search, notifications or generated account answer even when the mail body is removed.
WP-26 context policy and WP-30 meeting associations are not explicit WP-38 edges; without accepted equivalent ports, the published acceptance cannot be fulfilled by the eight receipts alone.
Safe-mode agent session is not a resource ACL or derived sharing guarantee; free-text uncited context would bypass WP-50 provenance.

Published filters/budget/pagination description conflicts with additionalProperties=false request fields; response status differs from the existing canonical triad. Silent schema expansion or status replacement would break consumers.
Renderer fallback-to-empty and swallowed transport errors could misreport unavailable/denied as authorized empty, or retain stale context after a principal/policy change.
Local dossier promises/notes/agent brief and local Meetings must remain available in explicit standalone mode; shared-mode fallback to those unrestricted stores is forbidden.
Migration identifier and foundational tables/transport registration are not yet available in scoped service paths; fabricated timestamps, tables or registry symbols would be unsupported.
Fixture tests, standalone regressions and provider health receipts cannot substitute for actual Company UI, citations, privacy and recovery observations on the integrated revision.
